limitations: Question-led visual review covered a roughly 10 s chronological frame grid for each full video plus original-resolution query/answer frames; the assistant did not watch every frame continuously or directly listen to original audio.
Local Whisper transcription and same-model bounded clip re-transcription are not independent ground truth.
Query and answer times were checked on sampled prefixes; intermediate seconds and exact source-frame event onset are not fully verified.
199 questions are audio-grounded and one requires audio and video. This is not a balanced modality benchmark.
No shortcut ablations or clinical expert review. Medical content must not be treated as clinical advice.
Source media paths point to complete files: the training loader must enforce video_window and audio_window; full ASR is annotation-only.
